verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an API/AI gateway and SaaS management platform like Kong/Konnect, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention periods, deletion APIs, or data-purge controls for logs, analytics, or AI traffic. The adjacent items don't count toward this story: DLP/PII sanitization of traffic, local log file locations, audit-log webhooks, and DB-less deployment are related features or user-side arrangements, not retention/deletion control.
